@PearsonEdexcel Hello Pearson. I would like to inquire about the IAL examination papers that end with an 'A' suffix, such as WPH11/01A. For the May/June 2026 and January 2026 examination series, which countries or regions are these papers supplied to? Are they provided exclusively to mainland China, or are they also administered in certain other countries and regions within the Asia-Pacific area?
Furthermore, how does Pearson strive to ensure fairness among candidates who are taking different versions of the examination papers?
